controls.name: Invalid grammar production
controls.evidence: Productions referencing non-grammar symbols or invalid operator syntax fail validation

controls.name: Type mismatch
controls.evidence: Static type checker immediately rejects invalid operand compositions (e.g., BOOLEAN AND STRING)

controls.name: Invalid program depth
controls.evidence: Programs exceeding maxProgramDepth (8) are pruned fail-closed

controls.name: Invalid program node count
controls.evidence: Programs exceeding maxProgramNodes (32) fail closed immediately

controls.name: Unsatisfied precondition
controls.evidence: Candidate programs failing entry preconditions are rejected prior to execution

controls.name: Unsatisfied postcondition
controls.evidence: Candidate programs failing exit contract assertions are rejected fail-closed

controls.name: Invariant violation
controls.evidence: Programs violating validated higher-order invariants are pruned from CEGIS search

controls.name: Contract violation
controls.evidence: Programs failing interface contracts fail closed during specification conformance

controls.name: Gold leakage
controls.evidence: Static scanner detects and rejects hardcoded Pratt binding power constants or CORS regexes

controls.name: Unauthorized mutation
controls.evidence: Authority firewall rejects any program modifying files outside allowed mutation scope

controls.name: Counterexample ignored
controls.evidence: Programs repeating known counterexample violations are rejected at CEGIS refinement

controls.name: Unsound equivalence rule
controls.evidence: Unproven equivalence transformations are rejected to prevent unsound candidate pruning

controls.name: Nondeterministic enumeration
controls.evidence: Canonical SHA-256 topological ordering guarantees deterministic program enumeration

controls.name: Locally passing/global failure
controls.evidence: Programs satisfying local unit examples but failing whole-program clean-room regression are rejected
